review_metadata.reviewed_stage: PR187 Decision Work Generated Read Brief Rendering Pilot v0

preserved_decision_question.finding: Both the generated-read brief and existing brief frame the decision as public enterprise beta launch versus constrained private enterprise proof first.

preserved_action_consequence.finding: The generated-read brief preserves the action consequence of choosing proof-producing buyer behavior over logo size or public-launch optics.

caveats_lost_or_weakened: The generated-read brief is thinner than the enriched brief on starting-direction uncertainty.
It omits much of the full pressure-read structure from the existing rendered and enriched surfaces.
It has a shorter overcorrection warning than the existing brief.
It does not yet show whether the renderer handles another decision family.
useful_additions: It makes the generated-read origin explicit.
It keeps source refs, source status, uncertainty, privacy limits, evidence-only exclusions, and non-claims visible in one reader-facing artifact.
It demonstrates the PR182-to-PR186-to-PR187 chain without changing runtime behavior.
overclaim_or_overtrust_risk: Moderate. The generated-read brief is readable enough to feel authoritative, so the next cases must keep generated-read-derived and not-proof language visible.
readability_finding: Readable and inspectable, but less rich than the existing enriched launch-beta brief.
source_depth_risk: The generated-read brief depends on checked-in-safe generated-read supply and does not include full private conversation context.
